item.title: InSAR from Scratch (I): What a Radar Interferometer Actually Measures
item.description: This is the first post in a series called Probabilistic InSAR. The end goal is to treat radar interferometry as a statistical estimation problem: given a noisy, wrapped, spatially correlated set of observations, recover the ground displacement signal we actually care about. Before any of that makes sense, we need to be precise about what a radar interferometer measures in the first place. That is the only goal of this post.
